works.title: Framework Creation Framework Book
works.description: A practical guide teaching users how to create AI frameworks at four capability tiers (Tier 0 with commercial APIs through Tier 4 with local models). Chapters restructured around the Boot system (boot-v1 through boot-v4) and the economics of each tier, covering tool access, system specifications, and framework methodology.
works.quote: I think the solution is to remove the tests from chapter 1 instead. A tier 0 user won't see poor results because the AI is doing all the work.
